title: Materialise Academy, design guidelines for aluminium (AlSi10Mg) metal 3D printing
notes: Service-bureau design guideline read on 2026-11-12; no publication date and no machine are shown. Layer thickness 0.09 mm (standard grade) and 0.06 mm (performance grade). Minimum wall 1 mm and 0.5 mm, with 2 mm recommended for structural walls. Minimum detail size 0.4 mm in the specification table, while the text says details as small as 0.5 mm are possible. Accuracy better than or equal to DCTG 6 of DIN EN ISO 8062-3 up to 30 mm, tabulated as plus or minus 0.2 mm. Under thermally induced stresses it advises rounding or filleting edges with a minimum radius of 3 mm and avoiding sharp edges. Powder-removal opening at least 3 mm, and long internal channels to be avoided without review. The 3 mm advice is a recommendation against build stresses on a service route with coarser layers than the EOS M 290 30 micrometre card; it is not a statement of the smallest radius the process resolves.
